title: There's a school next door
grammar: there is / there are; Questions with How many
vocab_topic: Expressions of location in the neighborhood; Places in the neighborhood
pair_game: Say a place. Your partner says “There’s a … near my home” or “There isn’t a … near my home.” Then swap!

grammar_box.title: There is / There are
rows: **Is there a** bazaar? Yes, there is.
grammar_box.tip: There is → There’s. How many + plural: How many shops are there? (Nechta?)

questions: What places are there in your neighborhood? Describe two or three.
How many schools are there near your home?
Is there a park or playground near your house? Do you go there?
How many students are there in your class?
What shops or stores are there near your school?
Describe your neighborhood — is it quiet or busy?
Is there a market or bazaar near your home? What can you buy there?
How many floors are there in your school building?
What place in your neighborhood do you visit most often?
Is there anything missing in your neighborhood that you wish was there?
starters: In my neighborhood, there’s a … and there are … .
There is/are … school(s) near my home.
Yes, there’s a … near my house. I go there … . / No, there isn’t.
There are … students in my class.
There’s a … and a … near my school.
My neighborhood is … . There are a lot of … .
Yes, there’s … bazaar near my home. I can buy … there.
There are … floors in my school building.
I visit the … most often. I go there with … .
There isn’t a … in my neighborhood. I wish there was a … .
samples: What places are there in your neighborhood? Describe two or three.
**There’s a** big park in my neighborhood. **There are** two shops and a café, too.
Is there a market or bazaar near your home? What can you buy there?
Yes, **there’s** Chorsu bazaar near my home. I can buy fruit, bread and spices there!
How many students are there in your class?
**There are** 28 students in my class. **There are** 15 girls and 13 boys.

mini_talk.title: My neighborhood
plan: Say how many shops or schools there are
mini_talk.model: Hi! I’m Bobur. I live in Chilonzor, Tashkent. **There’s a** big school near my home. **There are** three shops and a small café. **There isn’t a** cinema. **There’s a** park next to my house. I play football there with my friends. It’s my favourite place!
